about_the_game:
Survive a dinosaur-infested island.
Scavenge, craft, and fight for your life in Epoch Extinction, a top-down survival shooter where every step into the jungle could be your last. Supplies are scarce, raptors stalk the forests, and colossal predators roam the shadows.

Search abandoned houses, comb the forests, and scavenge what you can to stay alive. Every sound in the distance could be a predator on your trail—and every decision could be the difference between survival and extinction.

Epoch Extinction is developed by a solo indie developer, built step by step with community feedback.

Key Features

  • Survive the Wilds – Manage hunger, thirst, and health while scavenging for scarce resources.

  • Fight Dinosaurs – Raptors ambush from the brush, while massive predators like the T-Rex tower over you in deadly encounters.

  • Scavenge & Craft – Purify water, cook food, and improvise tools to endure the island’s dangers.

  • Open Exploration – Discover houses, lakes, and ruins filled with supplies and hidden dangers.

  • Atmospheric Survival – Tense environments, shifting day-night cycles, and constant threats create an immersive survival experience.

  • Lore Through Notes – Uncover scattered notes that reveal the stories of those who came before you.

Every choice matters. Do you risk the forest at night for supplies? Do you confront the raptor that stalks you, or try to sneak past in silence?
The island is alive, and it doesn’t forgive mistakes.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains depictions of violence, including combat with dinosaurs using firearms and melee weapons. Blood and injury effects are present, and both humans and dinosaurs may be shown as corpses. The game does not contain sexual content, drug use, or self-harm themes.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04+, SteamOS 3.0+, or other modern 64-bit Linux distribution
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 (4 GB, driver 535+) or AMD Radeon RX 470 (4 GB, Mesa 23.0+ / RADV) or Steam Deck APU equivalent
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04+, SteamOS 3.0+, or other modern 64-bit Linux distribution
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / 1660 SUPER (6 GB) or AMD RX 5500 XT (8 GB) / RX 590 (8 GB)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
